messages.content: Can you check the Silversmith and Palmer House for March 26 through March 29? I need one room for all three nights, not separate reservations.

The Silversmith conference rate is no longer available continuously: Thursday and Friday are open, but Saturday night is sold out at that rate. A higher flexible room can cover all three nights for $874.62 including taxes. The Palmer House still shows one room at the conference rate for the full stay, totaling $838.17 including taxes.
So the Palmer House is now less expensive as well as being at the conference venue?

Yes. On the current totals, Palmer House is $36.45 less than the only Silversmith option that avoids changing rooms or making separate bookings. It is also the conference hotel, so there would be no daily transit expense.
What are the cancellation terms on that Palmer House rate?

The displayed conference rate allows cancellation without penalty until 11:59 p.m. local hotel time on March 23. After that, the charge is one night's room and tax. It does not require advance payment, though a card is needed to guarantee the reservation. The quoted total includes taxes, and no separate destination fee is shown.
Please make sure the room is actually available for arrival Thursday and departure Sunday before I send this to our coordinator.

Confirmed: the listing covers check-in Thursday, March 26, and check-out Sunday, March 29, for three consecutive nights in one standard room. Check-in begins at 3:00 p.m., which works with the planned afternoon arrival.
All right. Prepare the exact hotel details for the reservation request, but do not say it has already been booked.

Reservation request: Palmer House, Chicago; one standard room for one guest; check-in Thursday, March 26; check-out Sunday, March 29; three nights at the conference rate. Current estimated total is $838.17 including taxes, with no separate destination fee displayed and no advance payment required. A card is required to guarantee the room. Cancellation is permitted without penalty through 11:59 p.m. Chicago time on March 23; afterward, one night's room and tax applies. Availability and the final total should be reconfirmed when the coordinator submits the reservation. The room is not yet booked.
